verdict.rationale: Execution time limits are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform like Railway, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents CPU-time or wall-clock limits for functions. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the ability to scale CPU and RAM, and cloud agents whose machines keep running after disconnect.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
